model: Leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) equivalent circuit — matches alexwoods1.github.io

comparator.role: Threshold detector (V ≥ V_th triggers spike output)

specs.supply_V: 2.2 to 36 (use ±9 V dual supply for headroom)
specs.threshold_behavior: Non-inverting input = V_membrane; inverting input = V_th reference

parts.example: Ohmite HVC0805T1005MJE or 100 MΩ 1% film (series if needed)
Murata GRM1885C1H221JA01D (220 pF NP0) or 200 pF C0G 1%
Precision divider from −9 V using OP07 buffer (scale per bench calibration)
Trimmer + precision divider into TLV1701 inverting input
SPST network to reset node when spike ends

spike_output.shape: Piecewise linear pulse (site uses symbolic +30 mV peak)
spike_output.note: Physical breadboard version: TLV1701 output drives astable or logic-level pulse; portfolio spike path is decorative
